items.title: A sober space with a dimension function is catenary, and the dimension function computes codimensions of closures
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the catenarity of a sober space carrying a dimension function, together with the exact formula computing codimensions of closures by the dimension function (author lemma at source lines 4082-4091, label lemma-dimension-function-catenary). The proof (source lines 4093-4107) is short but its mechanism is exact: sobriety supplies generic points of irreducible closed subsets, the defining properties of a dimension function bound the codimension by the difference of the values, and summing these bounds along a chain gives catenarity, while the same computation applied to a specialization yields the displayed identity (proof lines 4094-4106). H2.
